high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a modern bathroom. The individual is wearing a black sports bra with the word "BOSS" written on it and black leggings with beige accents. They have their hair tied back and are holding a phone with a green case that has a barcode design on it. The setting is a sleek, contemporary bathroom with dark tiles and a large mirror. On the countertop, there are two clear glass vases with a textured pattern and a small white soap dish containing a bar of soap.
